# Add OKF Spec Version Column

The migration script adds a new column 'okf_spec_version' to the 'compile_runs' table, allowing the storage of OKF specification versions associated with each compile's wiki emission. This enables tracking of the specification version used, aligning with existing versioning practices in the database.
